messages:
alex: quick a11y pass on Dashboard filter pill + chart tooltip interactions. noticed a few UX issues while tabbing. toni: drop notes here, was just reviewing keyboard flow earlier. alex: 1) Filter pills are focusable but the focus ring is barely visible on our light theme. looks like we rely on box-shadow with 0 alpha on some screens. 2) Chart tooltips are implemented as hover-only title attributes -> not reachable by keyboard or screen readers. 3) Decorative sparkline SVGs are being read by NVDA as 'graphic' with no name, cluttering the tree. fern: thanks. can you paste repro steps for each? alex: repro: open Dashboard -> tab to first filter pill ("Model") -> the pill gets keyboard focus but the visible outline is a 1px light shadow; contrast against bg is low so it disappears on zoom. Also when pressing Enter to open filter menu focus goes into a menu but when closing, focus doesn't return to the pill reliably. toni: sounds like missing focus-visible + restoreFocus on close. IIRC we have a focus manager util we can reuse. alex: yep. proposed quick fixes: - use :focus-visible to show 2px solid var(--accent-600) with outline-offset: 3px - ensure opener button has aria-expanded and the menu has role="menu" and aria-labelledby pointing to the button - on menu close, call focus() on the opener if not moving elsewhere fern: put CSS snippet? alex: ```css .filter-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-600); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: none; } ``` toni: good. about the chart tooltips? alex: tooltips: currently we render on mouseover with title attr; keyboard users can't access. suggestion: create a tooltip trigger that's focusable and use aria-describedby to point to a visually-hidden tooltip element that updates on focus/hover. For charts with many points, aggregate keyboard interaction: focus goes to the series-level summary, not every data point. fern: example markup? alex: ```html
Series A: peak 120 req/s at 3pm. avg 40 req/s.
``` toni: role="status" might announce on focus, but test with VoiceOver; sometimes role=status behaves differently. alternate: use aria-live="polite" on the sr-only element and update its text on focus. screenbot: accessibility scan: flagged 3 contrast failures in Dashboard header (pill label, timestamp small text) and 2 focusable elements missing accessible names. See report id 2026-03-22-DB-HDR. alex: noted. for decorative svgs add role="img" aria-hidden="true" or remove from DOM for screen reader users. also include elements for any informative svg icons. fern: agree. Also question about keyboard shortcut hints in the pill (we show ⌘K inline). that extra text is being picked up by screen readers and makes the label noisy. consider visually showing hint but wrapping it in an aria-hidden span. alex: example: <span class="pill-label">Search <span aria-hidden="true" class="kbd">⌘K</span></span> and add an accessible label on the button like aria-label="Search (press command K)" so screen reader users still get the shortcut but not the noisy inline chars. qa-bot: test plan suggestion: keyboard-only: tab order across header -> open/close pill menu -> verify focus restored; screen reader: VoiceOver + NVDA list of elements read; contrast: Automated WCAG 2.1 AA audit on staging after PR. toni: i'll take focus ring + restore focus + aria-expanded for pills. fern can you do svg/tooltip changes and update stories? fern: yes, will update storybook and add a keyboard-focused story. alex: please include notes in the PR: steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and testing matrix. tag me @alex for final a11y check. toni: ETA EOD for small PR. fern: ETA tomorrow AM for chart changes. screenbot: CI will run axe-core checks on the dashboard stories. failures will block merge. alex: thanks team :raised_hands: this should clean up a lot of noisy SR output and improve keyboard discoverability.
